title: Delegation brief (coordinator -> spoke)
description: Every delegation from the coordinator to a spoke agent is constructed against this shape before the Agent call is made. It is not sent to the spoke as literal JSON in the prompt -- it's the coordinator's own checklist for writing a self-contained brief, and the fields map 1:1 onto the corresponding prose sections of the brief text.

objective.description: What to produce, concretely. Not a vague goal -- a description specific enough that success/failure is unambiguous.

contract.description: The relevant slice of a shared interface (contracts.py, an API schema, a component prop type) pasted verbatim, or null if this task needs none. The spoke cannot see anything the brief doesn't contain.

scope.description: File paths/globs this agent owns for this task. Must match (or be a subset of) the owning agent's ownership map entry in CLAUDE.md.

negative.description: Explicitly out of scope: another agent's territory, forbidden actions (e.g. 'do not run git commands', 'do not edit main branch protection'), or things that look tempting but aren't this task's job.

rubric.description: How this will be judged: named tests that must pass, lint/type/modularity checks that must be clean, specific behaviors to verify. TDD tasks: the rubric names the test(s) written first.
